description: This file defines an abstract class 'PdfXObject' which serves as a base for external PDF objects within the PdfSharp library. It inherits from 'PdfDictionary' and is part of the 'PdfSharp.Pdf.Advanced' namespace. The class includes a constructor that initializes the object with a PdfDocument and a nested class 'Keys' for predefined dictionary keys.

classes.name: PdfXObject
classes.description: Abstract base class for all external PDF objects, providing common functionality and structure for PDF external objects.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: Nested class for predefined keys of the PdfXObject's dictionary.

methods.name: PdfXObject
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PdfXObject with the owning PdfDocument.
